data.gender_notes: Eashan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ईश (Isha), meaning 'God', 'Lord'. Eashan is a revered name in Hindu mythology, associated with powerful deities and spiritual enlightenment. The name Eashan carries the meaning “God, Lord” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Eashan usually hope their child will grow to embody god, lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eashan total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

In Hindu scriptures, several revered beings possess the name Eashan, including Lord Shiva, god of destruction, transformative time, and regeneration; Lord Rudra, the god of ancient wanderers and rites; and the sage Eash접ana, who is said to possess enlightened knowledge and wisdom.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu spirituality, the name Eashan represents a deep connection to the divine, signifying one's devotion, surrender, and reverence for the divine power. When someone is named Eashan, it instills within them a sense of duty, belief, and faith towards the divine bestower, thereby encouraging them to live a virtuous life and strive for spiritual growth. Amongst the Hindus, it is believed that the name has a transformative influence on the child, shaping their consciousness towards spiritual pursuits and an innate sense of devotion.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Eashan, meaning 'Lord of the Sun', is a Hindu name symbolizing the radiance and power of the divine Sun God, Surya. It represents the inner light and warmth that illuminates the spiritual path, guiding one towards enlightenment.
